steps.text: 11:41 P.M. \ Overcast
Lungmen District 7, City Gateway

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Inspector Hoshiguma, you're finally here!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, you sent me a message to get out here right when I was taking my shoes off, kid. Had to scramble across half of Lungmen in the dead of night.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: —So, what's with your perp?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Ahem, we, we apprehended her! She's in a holding cell for now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you got her? How many did it take?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Er, it was just me and another guy on duty...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You said she's a Victorian soldier... packing a pretty intimidating weapon too.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I don't get it either...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Before me and Ping even got close, she just dropped her weapon, stuck her hands way up and started yelling 'right here,' like she was worried we couldn't even see her.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Inspector, I've been on this gateway for a couple years now. I've never seen someone try to cross in like this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No worries, I'll go see what her deal is.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, right, you said in the message she was yelling something too?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: She's out there trying to speak mandarin Yanese, and not too well at that... but it sounded like she was saying, uh, Ch'en... Ch'en?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I might've just heard it wrong.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah... ha.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Alright, I'm up to speed.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Uwagh, that's bright—oh, did someone finally come?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, I've got a few questions to ask.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Is this... an interrogation?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Counts as one, I guess.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: *sigh* It was always me doin' the interrogatin' before. Suddenly the tables are all turned. Honestly, it's a new feelin' to me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you handed in your weapon all nicely... Didn't want to run?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ought to be a fair deal simple gettin' out of here, really... even without the Fortcracker...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: *cough* *cough* No, not that I mean to! Clean forgot you're interrogatin' me... um, I've got no thoughts of runnin' at all! I kept here voluntarily!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why? Hard to meet anyone who likes squatting in prisons.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I mean, I don't really want to be shut up. Just, I heard if I barged my way in the gate, police'd come arrest me... they're called the L.G.D. in Lungmen, right?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I was lookin' for someone, so, quickest method possible.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Find who, exactly?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Chenchen... I mean, right, Ch'en. She's in the L.G.D., right? I think she's already a... superintendent?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, what a shame. I thought she'd come over herself once she got the news, see.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What relationship do you and this supposed Superintendent Ch'en have?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We're best friends. We were classmates, back when she was at school in Victoria.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Which school?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Er, the Royal Guard Academy.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: In that case, you're an officer?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...I was before I left.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A retired Victorian officer, in uniform, gatecrashing a border city of another nation, with a standard weapon to boot—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Minus the bit where it fires shells! That part's removed!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But with the chambering system retained, it still has massive blast force. Am I right?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Quietly) Goin' by the rulebook, I really should've handed it in to the brass...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Which is to say, you didn't have an ordinary retirement?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well, that question came fast.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, if I knew this day was comin', I would've tried a little harder back in interrogation theory.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you that keen on covering up the details of your retirement? Miss, if you're a deserter, then I should be on the phone already.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No, please don't call anyone—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I—I really am out of the force, I can promise you that!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'll try and explain, but—there's some info I just... am not at liberty to reveal here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Go for it, then.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Alright, here's the thing. Three months ago, I was still in the army, and our team was trackin' this case.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Durin' our investigation... um...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I can't say anythin' but, because of this case, out of our team, the only one presently still alive... no, still able to freely operate is me, now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm sorry. It must be rough to remember.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Thank you for understandin'.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That said, I'm not clear on something. You almost gave your life, so shouldn't the old Victorian Army fogies have been covering you in medals?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You mean, gettin' decorated? Forget it, the investigation's not complete. That never even crossed my mind.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But at the very least... I thought they could send a few more hands to help me stay on the trail.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And they didn't?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Really floors you, doesn't it? Officer, I make less sense of it than you do.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I started out searchin' for all kinds. Started from County Peninsula's barracks, and all of them were trippin' to placate me, havin' me wait for orders from above, pledgin' I'd have more hands ASAP.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And I heeded that. In the end, I realized I was just wastin' more and more time, and the investigation was dead in its tracks for it. So, I decided to circumvent the place's barracks, and get straight in touch with Londinium.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Wasn't too easy doin' it, but luckily I'd already built up a little experience on how to deal with barracks, and you'll always run into good people on the way forward.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Finally, I made it in one piece to the closest camp to Londinium—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And there, I made my decision to retire.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Because they still didn't help you?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Commanders, counts, the grand dukes... they probably had other concerns. They told me so, at least, and there I was swallowin' it all, right until the day...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I accidentally overheard. A lieutenant colonel with some other officer I didn't recognize, discussin' what to do with me.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye. I never thought—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Thirty-seven whole days past the event, and I wasn't sittin' waitin' for any reinforcements. Only an order to transfer.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This can't have been easy for you.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mm... I feel a right mess inside. Is it hurt? Or disappointment, or anger... I can't even say.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: When I learned, my brain just went pure white. Only thought I could keep was I was glad I left my spear in the trainin' room, and didn't have it to hand.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Otherwise, you would've done something?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Wouldn't have, really... probably. After all, I've always remembered my own duty.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And just the same, as a Victorian serviceman, I had to obey orders.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But... in that moment, I realized I couldn't do it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Armies don't much care for insubordination.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye. And with that, I settled on it pretty quickly. I'd leave the army myself before they decided where I ought to go.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did they agree to let you go?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Retirement procedures went smooth enough. Leader and Chenchen used to complain how stubborn I was. Of course a lieutenant colonel and his lot couldn't do a thing to stop it.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But, when I was at the camp to hand my weapons back in, I got ambushed.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A surprise attack? From who? The one you were after?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's very likely.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I've gone over it in my head. Why would they choose to act at the barracks, when they clearly didn't care for a whole month about me...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Maybe the enemy sneaked their way into army admin, in the end? Or maybe just from the start...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, none of it matters anymore.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I fought a few off, but they had masses of people. Couldn't help but pick up my spear and hurry on my way out.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And then? That's how you fled Victoria?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Fled's... not wrong. Haha. It's been real rough and tumble comin' all this way.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I know how tall an order it is to deal with those bunch. Didn't dare go home, naturally. Didn't want the ghosts gettin' my mum and them caught up too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Goin' back to the army's even more out of the question, and I'd just be hasslin' the police if I went to them. Kept waverin', thinkin' for an answer...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You could only turn to classmates?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mm, that's right. Chenchen promised, if anythin' happened to me, I could go find her!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Er, officer, what are you laughin' at?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's nothing. So, you came to Lungmen.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That's where she is for certain. I haven't got it wrong, have I? Her New Year message last year came from this place and all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's keep talking about why you broke past our gateway.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No matter if you've got people hunting you down, you're a Victorian citizen anyway. You're not telling me you can't even buy a ticket somewhere?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...I honestly can't.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Huh? Professional Victorian servicemen take home less than Lungmen street stalls?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Err, that's not it.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I, um... lost my wallet and passport both in Leithanien.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You might be my kinda girl, huh...?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: —They got blown to nothin'. Not even cinders left.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're definitely my kinda girl.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Not just the wallet, I was a hair from bein' sent flyin' too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'd only just left Victoria at that point. Rubbed shoulders with a caravan car crossin' Leithanien.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hadn't been in the country for two days when the car passed this wee city. The local viscount was a fair deal happy to welcome us, and even set us up in the nicest inn and all.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: When it came evenin', the others went to this meal, and I stayed by myself in this whole luxury suite they gave me. Waiter gave me a supper meal, totally complimentary.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I had a few bites. Always felt Leithanian food was too refined for me, never much suited my palate. Just wanted to go outside and find a farmer's market to saunter about for a while.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Didn't think as soon I was downstairs, there'd be a boom, and the window frame for my room'd go crunch right in front of me. Completely mangled up, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's an intense explosion for sure.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It was! Even I might've lost my life if I got blown out a window ten floors up, y'know?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Only might've?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's serious, look, I swear! Honestly didn't expect to be so in for it even in Leithanien.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm. Your mind and body both seem much sturdier than that poor window frame.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh? Thanks... for the praise?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Come to mention it, do you know who tried to blow you up?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No idea. I'd only been with the caravan for a few days, pitchin' in my strength. Shouldn't have made any enemies, right?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Actually... I'm not that worried about gettin' an answer to that question.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ever since I started investigatin' this case, the riddles have piled on up, and there's been no moment of clarity at any point. Gotten used to it already.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So, by coming to Lungmen, you were hoping to lean on your friend?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, I'm not lookin' for others to protect me, no. I just wanted to ask Chenchen if she'd be willin' to help me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh? You still want to go back to Victoria to finish the job? Even with so many people out for you?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right you are.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Not a single hint of hesitation, either.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Exhale—)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's been a few months for me, goin' from Victoria to Lungmen. Suppose I had even the slightest hesitation, I couldn't have gone this way.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I promised, I'd get the truth of it all out for all to see.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If I don't know where that truth is, I'll go lookin'—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If the enemy don't want me talkin', then I swear I'll talk.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I left Victoria without lookin' back. But if I'm all readied to return one day, then I will not waver one step.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're not scared?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Right. I believe you.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Warriors who keep saying they're not scared of dying are either bluffing, or they haven't gotten it yet.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I think you've made the preparations you need to, and I believe you aren't lying.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So, in that case, can you help me get in touch with Che... Superintendent Ch'en?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Here, there's a few cha siu baau in this bag. They're pretty much cooled. If you can put up with that, they're edible. I'm guessing you're starved after running all this way through the wasteland?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Even a Vouivre as intrepid as you's gotta have her mealtimes.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mmffm...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...so tasty...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Er, wait, is this part of the interrogation too?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Part of it? It ended a while ago.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I was thinkin' you'd ask me some about me and Chenchen's past, check if I was lyin' or not...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What I needed to know, I long since knew.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Um, wait, wait. It just came to me. I know you too. You're the L.G.D.'s Hoshi... Hoshi...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hoshi... hoshi? Ha ha, you'd be better off not calling me that. Especially not in front of them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How about this, Bagpipe. We'll stick to code, and you stay in this room just a little longer. I'll step out for a moment to see someone.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Finished grilling?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why not go in yourself, curious as you are?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Is there anything worth the curiosity?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Rhodes Island's people are all on their way. She can't stay here for long.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If I've kept track of the time right, they should be here now.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph, that puk gaai Lung. Who knows where she's frolicking about right now while we're left working overtime.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If Ch'en heard her old classmate walked a million miles looking for her, she'd be at least a little ruffled.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: She won't say it, but she's always been loyal to her friends, Missy, and you know that.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What do her friends matter to me?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And you, you absolutely sent a message to Rhodes Island the moment you got the tip-off. Why the effort to interrogate her too? Do you love it, playing the bad cop?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Best to go through proper procedures, what with all the kids on the force watching.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Besides, don't you wanna do a little finding out, see what new dangers old Ch'en might get into?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ...No thank you.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ugh, I'm so done with this! Once Rhodes Island picks her up from in there, you're giving me a clear, thorough report... No slacking!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha, alright.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Look, here's the Rhodes Island operator to lead her away—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ehhhhh, what?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So Chenchen's actually left the L.G.D. already? You're telling me I need to go somewhere else now?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Er, what was that company called...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: —Rhooodes—Island?
